bio: Just one colour, a bracing white, defines the décor. Decorative plates were crafted by the chef’s mother, featuring motifs that reflect the mother and daughter’s love for both food and poems by the Kenji Miyazawa. The seeds of Izumi Tanaka’s love for cuisine were planted when she was little; yearning to own her own restaurant, she set off for France. The vigorous flavours of French ingredients and the delicious ways they overlap enthralled her. Each month she creates a new theme for her prix fixe menus. Brimming with imagination and playfulness, the menus and their impish illustrations will have you grinning before you know it....
